reply:
That changes it completely. The feeder isn’t a ten-second task you’ve been avoiding — it’s the one job that requires the room to be safe first. Standing at a wall with the ceiling torn open and reaching out over it is not a "just pick it up" situation.

So Monday-to-now isn’t neglect. It’s that the feeder is downstream of the repair, and the repair hasn’t happened.

One thing I want to check, because "with my feet" could mean a couple of things: are you barefoot on a wet floor, or is it the standing-and-reaching-over-the-open-ceiling part that’s the real problem? If it’s the reach, I’d leave it down until he’s patched the ceiling — or use something long-handled from a safe distance rather than leaning out. A feeder can wait. You leaning over an open ceiling can’t.
